description: Canonical LLM task-to-model routing matrix. Single source of truth for which model handles which task across all services. Every hardcoded model reference in backend/orchestrator/rlm-engine must route through this matrix. Hardcoded literals outside this file are a governance violation.

attestation.description: Validate tool output as structured JSON {valid, confidence, issues[]}. Must return parseable JSON reliably.
attestation.rationale: Mercury's diffusion architecture exhausts reasoning token budget on structured JSON output. 2026-04-29 update: qwen-plus demoted from primary to last-resort after live benchmark of /reason endpoint surfaced deterministic phantom role-play on platform-internal tokens (PhantomBOM, BOMItem, pheromone). Pattern is fine-tuning-baked, not prompt-fixable. DeepSeek V3.2 (deepseek-chat) is now primary attestation model — strong structured JSON, 1.2s avg latency. Note: All models in chain must be openai_compatible=true for callModelFromMatrix to work.

extraction_short.description: Short-prompt entity/field extraction (prompt < 500 tokens). Speed matters, quality is acceptable with short outputs.
extraction_short.rationale: 2026-06-19: mercury-2 (provider inception) removed — provider is runtime-unavailable, so it was a dead primary that fell through to fallback on every call (LIN matrix drift). qwen-plus now primary for short prompts; mercury can be re-added as a tail fallback if Inception returns.

extraction_long.description: Long-prompt entity extraction with detailed rules or many fields. Mercury unsafe here.

classification.rationale: 2026-06-06: gemini-2.0-flash retired (EOL, /v1beta 404) → gemini-2.5-flash-lite (newest, cheapest Flash). 2026-06-19: mercury-2 removed as primary — provider inception runtime-unavailable, so it dead-fell-through every call; gemini-2.5-flash-lite promoted to primary.

fold_context.description: Context folding / compression — reduce large context to fit downstream token budget.
fold_context.rationale: Mercury-2 was never wired to LLM folding (only local compressors used). 2026-06-06: gemini-2.0-flash retired (EOL, /v1beta 404) → gemini-2.5-flash; 1M context window ideal for large-context compression, multimodal strength aligns with polyglot input. Haiku removed: chain now tests real LLM summarization path.

chat_standard.description: Standard chat / conversational responses. Balance cost and quality.
chat_standard.rationale: 2026-06-06: gemini-2.0-flash retired (EOL, /v1beta 404) → gemini-2.5-flash-lite (newest, cheapest Flash) as the Gemini fallback tier for standard chat.

chat_premium.description: Premium chat — highest-quality conversational output for critical user interactions.
chat_premium.rationale: 2026-04-29: qwen3-235b-a22b suspended from premium-chat primary slot. Live /reason benchmark showed deterministic memorized phantom role-play on tasks containing platform-internal tokens (PhantomBOM, BOMItem). DeepSeek V3.2 (chat) now primary, R1 (reasoner) for complex logic backup, GPT-4o as paid premium fallback.

code_generation.description: Generate code from natural language or spec.
code_generation.rationale: 2026-05-27: qwen3-235b-a22b removed after deployed runtime observed DashScope/OpenAI-compatible 404. qwen-plus remains the verified Qwen fallback model in this matrix.

planning.description: Task decomposition, multi-step planning, architecture design.
planning.rationale: 2026-04-29: qwen3-235b-a22b removed from planning chain. Phase Δ plan-critique benchmark surfaced memorized phantom role-play. DeepSeek R1 (reasoner) is best-in-class for multi-step planning per user direction; V3.2 standby for high-throughput plan iterations. 2026-06-19: claude-sonnet-4-6 added as a frontier-tier fallback (1M context, adaptive thinking) ahead of gpt-4o — raises the Anthropic reasoning ceiling above haiku at controlled cost.

reasoning_deep.description: Deep reasoning over complex problems. Latency acceptable.
reasoning_deep.rationale: 2026-04-29: qwen3-235b-a22b suspended from deep-reasoning chain. R1 = primary (logic-heavy CoT, transparent thinking), V3.2 = standby (high-throughput RAG). Note: R1 emits <think>...</think> blocks — consumers MUST strip these before JSON parse via _parse_reasoning_payload's tolerant first-{-to-last-} extraction. 2026-06-19: claude-sonnet-4-6 added as a frontier-tier fallback (1M context, adaptive thinking) ahead of gpt-4o — explicit decision to lift the Anthropic reasoning ceiling above the prior haiku-only cap.

multimodal.description: Image / document / vision input. Requires multimodal-capable provider.
multimodal.rationale: 2026-06-06: gemini-2.0-flash retired (EOL, /v1beta 404) → gemini-2.5-flash for image/document/vision input.

ner.description: Named entity recognition over domain text.
ner.rationale: 2026-06-06: gemini-2.0-flash retired (EOL, /v1beta 404) → gemini-2.5-flash-lite (newest, cheapest Flash) for named-entity recognition.

self_healing.description: Auto-repair of broken code / failed tests / runtime errors.
self_healing.rationale: 2026-05-27: qwen3-235b-a22b removed after deployed runtime observed DashScope/OpenAI-compatible 404. qwen-plus remains the verified Qwen fallback model in this matrix.

embedding_text.description: Generate text embeddings for semantic search / RAG.
embedding_text.rationale: Embedding dims MUST match consumer index. NEXUS graph = 384D (all-MiniLM-L6-v2), Non-NEXUS = 1536D (text-embedding-3-small). NEVER mix dimensions within one index.

consulting_assessment.description: Generate McKinsey-grade strategic assessments using Pyramid Principle + MECE. Output: self-contained HTML widget.
consulting_assessment.rationale: 2026-06-18: gemini-2.5-flash first (multimodal + HTML generation quality). deepseek-chat as cost-effective fallback. qwen-plus as final fallback. Chain ensures provider-agnostic consulting output.

consulting_storyline.description: Generate MECE storyline outlines for consulting presentations. Output: structured JSON (slides array).
consulting_storyline.rationale: 2026-06-18: same chain as consulting_assessment — storyline requires same reasoning depth. Output is JSON not HTML so any provider can generate valid structure.

consulting_deliverable.description: Generate formal consulting deliverables: executive summaries, roadmaps, DOCX/PPT content. Output: markdown or JSON.
consulting_deliverable.rationale: 2026-06-18: deepseek-chat first for structured long-form text (cost-efficient). gemini-2.5-flash as fallback for complex multi-format output. qwen-plus as final fallback.

infra_fallback.description: Backend-infrastructure fallback: used when the backend unified ingress returns 5xx (deploy window / restart). Bypasses the ingress and calls providers directly. Chain is tried in order until one succeeds.
infra_fallback.rationale: Gemini leads because it has a native direct-call path (callGemini). DeepSeek and Qwen follow as openai-compat providers with direct key access. All three have API keys on the orchestrator Railway service.
